title: Australian Frittata with Jewel Toned Vegetables
description: A fusion of Japanese and Italian flavors, this frittata is packed with Australian vegetables and a hint of sweetness from the jewel toned vegetables.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the sliced zucchini and cook until it starts to soften.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the frittata is golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to loosen the edges of the frittata and slide it onto a plate.
